One Private Room in East Village
One furnished private room available in East Village. We're 2 working professionals in our 20s and 30s looking to fill one of our spots for at least 3 months, potentially longer. Aiming for an early April move-in date, but we can be flexible.

Our apartment is in a great community in The East Village. We are a 5-minute walk to Target, Trader Joe's, and Whole Foods Express. We're also a 5-minute walk to the L Train's 1st Avenue Stop & uptown buses. Union Square is a 15-minute walk from there.

The room and apartment come furnished and include heat, air conditioning, and elevator access. A dresser and dedicated closet space will be provided for clothing storage. We have a laundry room in the building. Our community has 24-hour security.

Rent is $2,230 and includes all utilities.

Rent must be paid on time and in full each month. We will ask for recent paystubs from your employer, a snapshot of your credit score, and a recent bank account statement. A security deposit of one month’s rent is also required.

We’re both pretty career oriented but also like to enjoy all that New York has to offer. If we’re not working, we’re usually working out, going out with friends in the city, or going to concerts. Looking for someone who is equally as motivated and respectful. We don’t mind you having people over or drinking, but we prefer to keep it pretty lowkey. No smoking or pets allowed.

Ideally you're already in NYC and able to see the place in person.

If you meet the above criteria, feel free to send a message telling us about yourself - your line of work, what your routine week looks like, your hobbies, etc. We'd also like to know your age and what your current housing situation looks like.
